blocker_glossary.MODALITY: must / should / may / can / is responsible for - no deontic or alethic operator in the grammar
blocker_glossary.DISJUNCTION: or / whether-or inside the claim - the grammar has conjunction only
blocker_glossary.QUANTIFIER: most / many / often / generally / primarily, or a comparative or superlative - the grammar has only every/some/no
blocker_glossary.ATTRIBUTE: adjectival or literal values (timely, accurate, well-trained) - terms are class names or variables only
blocker_glossary.EVALUATIVE: vague evaluative predicate (crucial, difficult, significant, important) with no formal content
blocker_glossary.TEMPORAL: continuity, ordering, or aspect (continuously, throughout, in advance of, currently)
blocker_glossary.SCOPED_NEGATION: negation inside a restrictive clause - not applies to a whole atomic assertion only
blocker_glossary.CONDITION: a condition the grammar cannot state (gerund clause, when appropriate, when available)
blocker_glossary.PURPOSIVE: the claim lives in a to-... / in-order-to-... purpose clause
blocker_glossary.ATTITUDE: propositional attitude (the Army views ... as, JP 2-0 recognizes)
blocker_glossary.REFERENCE: unresolved anaphora (it, they, this) in the claim
blocker_glossary.META: document self-reference or bibliography (ATP 2-22.7 provides ..., see chapter 5, Figure 1-2)
